question: Can a causal gate use a computation branch without sacrificing the unchanged raw reference, beyond ordinary ensembling?
motivation: V30 best8 fails both raw/reference full-span opportunity despite positive arithmetic ranking. No extension of that reward branch is proposed.

mechanism.reference: Frozen unchanged B0 on original prefix and already-observed/generated continuation history. The degraded trained raw path cannot replace this reference.
mechanism.assisted_branch: Fixed candidate writer/reader initially; no joint policy optimization. Existing first-order V29 model is a possible engineering asset, not a chosen scientific winner.
mechanism.distribution: p_mix(y|h,z)=(1-a(h,z))*p_B0(y|h)+a(h,z)*p_assisted(y|h,z). Both branches must be normalized on the same vocabulary.
mechanism.gate_inputs: Only native prefix, generated calculation, previous observed/generated tokens, pre-target hidden states or complete predictive distributions. Current gold token, gold LP, annotated numeral masks and hindsight best-of-G are forbidden gate features.

gate_bound.proof: p_mix(y)>= (1-a)*p_B0(y); thus logp_mix(y)-logp_B0(y)>=log(1-a)>=-.03 for every target. This is a probability mixture, not interpolation of logits/log probabilities.
gate_bound.limits: A cost bound gives no positive-gain or accuracy guarantee. Causality, normalization and an unchanged reference are required.

mechanism.initialization: An interior small gate can preserve this bound while giving a gate gradient; an exact zero contribution suppresses content-dependent writer reward. Freeze writer/reader first rather than promising zero-cost autonomous bootstrap.

required_controls_before_any_claim: Unchanged B0 raw, as primary practical baseline.
Fixed probability blend specified from the mathematical cap, without tuning on V30 outcomes.
Comparable gated B0 plus source-trained raw branch, to separate thought content from ordinary model ensembling.
Same gate and assisted-reader computation with empty/intact unrelated calculations.
Competitive ordinary CoT and exact-interpreter control for computable arithmetic, with actual inference/training cost accounted separately.
scope_limits: This is an inference/read-interface mechanism, not a better direct base model or internalization result. A frozen raw path cannot improve by definition.
A gate computed after generating the note does not avoid its generation cost.
Two prediction paths incur real extra work; a separate checkpoint/reference must earn that complexity. No practical superiority is presumed.
Conditional probability mixtures are known; learned mixing is prior work. Do not claim novelty from adding a gate.
V30 gold-token LPs could produce a hindsight routing curve, but cannot train or validate a causal gate. Do not run another fixed-mixer sweep on this inspected panel as confirmation.
The V29 raw-loop audit finds the intended objective, not the cause of regression. A future CPT claim still needs a credible uniform-NTP/source control and independent endpoints.
remaining_before_model_calls: Choose whether this bounded inference mechanism is worth its complexity relative to the training-side north star; it is not automatically the next main experiment.
Specify causal feature/cache interface, exact normalization, reference identity, comparison budgets and fresh source-separated training/development cohorts.
Predeclare one primary gain over both B0 and non-thought ensemble controls, full16 endpoint, uncertainty unit and stopping rule.
Freeze a finite numerical qualification and complete-question review. No current release permits feature-model calls, gate learning, RL or CPT.

prior_art.relevance: Learned post-thought mixing and the zero-mixing reward problem; not a proof that this proposed probability-floor mechanism learns useful routing.
Group-relative predictive policy objective. Common offsets cancel; fixed-reward improvement arguments do not supply positive absolute reward or guarantee shared-reader finite-step dynamics.
